pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hotel and hostel hybrid in Marseille’s La Joliette district, with private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and a courtyard pétanque court.

Family and budget stay

Book a whole private family room and confirm beds, occupancy and cot needs. Dormitory beds are separate products. A shared guest kitchen and laundry facilities can help with longer stays; check equipment, storage, charges and house rules. The courtyard includes a pétanque court.

The hotel is in La Joliette, with metro access for exploring Marseille. Plan walking distances to the Old Port and other sights with children or luggage. Compare the full private-room cost, city tax, breakfast, parking, luggage storage and cancellation terms for the actual dates.

Guest feedback

Families praise the kitchen, practical rooms and helpful staff. Accounts also note limited communal fridge space, youth-group noise, paid luggage storage and refund concerns. These are guest reports; read current feedback and room-specific terms. Scores are a dated snapshot.

Opening and development

TourMag’s February 2022 report confirms the hotel opened on 19 January 2022, with 194 rooms and 572 beds. These opening-era figures are separate from earlier plans.

COFFIM’s delivery announcement describes the completed building at 25–27 rue de Forbin in December 2021, with 194 rooms and 572 beds. Building handover precedes the guest opening. No property-specific construction investment was verified.

pin.longFormSummary:
A family resort in Perryville, Maryland, with suites, indoor water-park access included in overnight stays, and additional paid attractions.

Family water-park stay

Select the exact suite, beds and booked occupancy; themed and larger suites have different layouts and limits. Overnight stays include indoor water-park access, subject to operating hours, height rules, wristbands and supervision requirements. Confirm arrival-day and departure-day access for the booking.

Daily family activities are included, while Adventure Park attractions, the arcade, food, parking and other extras can add to the bill. Compare the complete stay cost and current packages. This resort joins Family; no current all-in budget rate was verified.

Guest feedback

Families praise the water park, activities and friendly staff. Recent accounts also describe crowds, long hallways, limited seating, inconsistent housekeeping and expensive extras. These are guest reports; check suite space, walking distances and current service policies. Scores are a dated snapshot.

Formal opening and investment

The Maryland Marketing Partnership dates the formal grand opening and ribbon-cutting to 29 June 2023. The event pin represents that ceremony, distinct from earlier preview stays in June.

The operator’s opening release describes investment of more than US$250 million by shareholders. The numeric project price records the published US$250 million lower bound; the source does not give an exact total. This covers the resort development and is not a room rate.

The current operator profile lists 700 suites and a 126,000-square-foot indoor water park. The opening release described the water park as 128,000 square feet; the different source figures are not silently combined. Suite occupancy depends on category.
